name: Toot Bus
overview: Toot Bus is Paris's premium hop-on hop-off sightseeing service, offering panoramic views of the city's major attractions from open-top double-decker buses. With multiple routes and multilingual audio guides, it's an ideal way to explore Paris at your own pace.
history: Toot Bus began operations in Paris as part of the City Sightseeing global network, providing convenient tourist transportation around major European cities. The service has evolved to offer eco-friendly buses and enhanced digital experiences.
highlights: Eiffel Tower - iconic iron lattice tower and Paris symbol
Arc de Triomphe - triumphal arch at Champs-Élysées western end
Louvre Museum - world's largest art museum with glass pyramid
Place de la Concorde - largest public square in Paris
Invalides - Napoleon's tomb and military museums
Trocadéro - best Eiffel Tower viewing platform
Open-top buses with multilingual audio commentary (8+ languages)
tips: Start early to maximize your day ticket. Sit on upper deck for best views and photos. Download the app for real-time bus tracking. Tickets include Seine river cruise combo options. Avoid rush hours for quicker boarding.
